capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned robinhood block 79299257 (hash 0x08773688fa49ad28274d7479204a50a6ef3feb23903f3ea10b3f8e73dca1dffa). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Inherited controls concern usdg-paxos, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.
